spec.expr:
# 0 == unhealthy, 1 == error, 2 == healthy
sum by (protocol, hostname, port) (
    (gwm_http_endpoint_error{$cluster_label=~"$cluster", protocol="$protocol", hostname="$httproute_hostname", port="$port"} == 1)
    or 2 * max_over_time(gwm_http_endpoint_up{$cluster_label=~"$cluster", protocol="$protocol", hostname="$httproute_hostname", port="$port"}[5m])
)
gwm_http_endpoint_error{$cluster_label="$cluster", hostname=~"$httproute_hostname", protocol="$protocol", port="$port"}
gwm_tls_endpoint_error{$cluster_label="$cluster", hostname=~"$tlsroute_hostname", port="$port"}

# 0 == unhealthy, 1 == error, 2 == healthy
sum by (protocol, hostname, port) (
    (gwm_tls_endpoint_error{$cluster_label=~"$cluster", hostname="$tlsroute_hostname", port="$port"} == 1)
    or 2 * max_over_time(gwm_tls_endpoint_up{$cluster_label=~"$cluster", hostname="$tlsroute_hostname", port="$port"}[5m])
)
gwm_http_endpoint_status_code{$cluster_label="$cluster", hostname=~"$httproute_hostname", protocol="$protocol", port="$port"}

(count(gwm_http_endpoint_error{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 1) or vector(0))
+ (count(gwm_tls_endpoint_error{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 1) or vector(0))

(count(sum by (hostname) (gwm_http_endpoint_error{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0))
+ (count(sum by (hostname) (gwm_tls_endpoint_error{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0))

(count(sum by (hostname) (gwm_http_endpoint_up{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 1)) or vector(0))
+ (count(sum by (hostname) (gwm_tls_endpoint_up{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 1)) or vector(0))

(count(sum by (hostname) (gwm_http_endpoint_up{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 0)) or vector(0))
+ (count(sum by (hostname) (gwm_tls_endpoint_up{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 0)) or vector(0))

count(
    (sum by (hostname) (gwm_http_endpoint_not_after{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} - time())) < 0
    or on ($cluster_label, protocol, hostname, port) 
    (sum by (hostname) (gwm_http_endpoint_trust{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 0))
) or vector(0)
+
count(
    (sum by (hostname) (gwm_tls_endpoint_not_after{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} - time()) < 0)
    or on ($cluster_label, hostname, port) 
    (sum by (hostname) (gwm_tls_endpoint_trust{$cluster_label=~"$cluster"} == 0))
) or vector(0)

spec.name: cluster_label
spec.description: The label used to differentiate Kubernetes clusters.
